blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Alas Pilipinas’ Sofiah Pagara and Khy Progella emerged as the last Filipino pair standing after the Philippines was denied an all-Filipino semifinals affair in the Asian Games women’s beach volleyball on Wednesday. Pagara and Progella booked their fifth straight win, outlasting Japanese Ren and Non Matsumoto, 24-22, 22-20, on Wednesday at Hekinan Ryokuchi Beach Court. However, Sisi Rondina and Bernadeth Pons weren’t able to forge an all-Philippines showdown after falling short against Thailand’s Taravadee Naraphonapat and Worapeerachayakorn Kongphopsarutawadee, 17-21, 21-12, 13-15.
